name: lovable-cloud-to-supabase-exporter-workspace
description: Toolkit for migrating Lovable Cloud projects to Supabase.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.api:dev: pnpm api:bootstrap && concurrently -k -n core,cli,api "pnpm --filter @dreamlit/lovable-cloud-to-supabase-exporter-core dev" "pnpm --filter lovable-cloud-to-supabase-exporter dev" "pnpm --filter lovable-cloud-to-supabase-exporter serve:watch"
scripts.cloudflare:worker:dev: cd packages/cloudflare-exporter-worker && pnpm dlx wrangler dev
scripts.cloudflare:worker:deploy: cd packages/cloudflare-exporter-worker && pnpm dlx wrangler deploy --keep-vars --containers-rollout immediate
scripts.cloudflare:worker:deploy:staging: cd packages/cloudflare-exporter-worker && pnpm dlx wrangler deploy -e staging --containers-rollout immediate --secrets-file .dev.vars.staging
scripts.prepare: if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then lefthook install; fi
